question: Which Hindustani classical musician is credited with popularising the Sarangi as a solo classical instrument?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pandit Ram Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan** is a renowned Hindustani classical musician credited with popularizing the **Sarangi** as a solo classical instrument.
 
• Before his efforts, the **Sarangi** was primarily associated with accompanying vocal performances and was not widely regarded as a solo instrument.
 
• He elevated the status of the **Sarangi** through his innovative and virtuosic performances, showcasing its potential for intricate and expressive music.
 
• **Born** in Udaipur, Rajasthan, in **1927**, Pandit Ram Narayan began his musical journey at an early age.
 
• He developed a unique playing style that brought out the instrument's melodic and emotional depth, earning him international recognition.
 
• Pandit Ram Narayan was the first to perform **Sarangi** recitals in major concert venues worldwide, firmly establishing it as a respected solo instrument in Hindustani classical music.
 
• He has received numerous accolades, including the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** in 2005, for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• His efforts paved the way for future generations of Sarangi players, inspiring many to take up the instrument as a soloist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pandit Jnan Prakash Ghosh**__

 __
 
• **Pandit Jnan Prakash Ghosh** was a prominent Indian musician and composer, but he was not directly associated with the Sarangi.
 
• He is best known for his contributions to **tabla** and Hindustani classical compositions.
 
• He also played a pivotal role as a teacher and mentor to many renowned Indian classical musicians.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar**__
 __
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was a legendary sitar maestro and one of the most well-known Indian classical musicians worldwide.
 
• He is credited with popularizing the sitar and Indian classical music on the global stage, particularly in the West.
 
• He collaborated with several Western musicians, including **George Harrison** of The Beatles.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma**__
 
 
• **Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma** was a virtuoso of the **Santoor**, a traditional Kashmiri instrument.
 
• He was instrumental in adapting the Santoor to Hindustani classical music and elevating its status as a solo instrument.
 
• He is renowned for his compositions and collaborations, including the famous Shiv-Hari duo with **Hariprasad Chaurasia**.
